thesis_statement: Lockheed Martin is the largest US defense prime (F-35, missiles and missile defense, space), with a record $230B backlog and elevated US and allied demand for munitions and interceptors; the thesis is steady cash generation and dividends now that 2025's program charges are behind it.

base.summary: Mid-to-high single-digit sales growth with recovering segment margins and free cash flow above $7B.

bull.summary: Multi-year munitions contracts and allied demand push growth and margins above guidance.

bear.summary: New fixed-price program charges return, or budget pressure hits F-35 or classified programs.
drivers: US budget continuing resolution or cuts

key_risks: Fixed-price development risk: Q2 2025 carried $1.6B of program losses, so year-over-year EPS (+444%) mostly reflects that base effect.
Budget and policy timing risk, including continuing resolutions and F-35 quantity changes.
Overlaps with ITA (LMT is about 4.7% of ITA), so their signals are not independent.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the live guarded-SQL reference_invalidation_level (496.71 at the 2026-09-26 renewal). SQL governs after any later renewal; this text does not.
fundamental: A new program-loss charge above $500M in any quarter.
Full-year free cash flow guidance cut below $6B, or an enacted real-terms cut to the US defense budget.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026: sales $20.1B +11%; net earnings $1.8B ($7.94/share) vs $342M ($1.46) in Q2 2025 which included $1.6B program losses; OCF $3.2B, FCF $2.9B; $65B new orders; record backlog $230B incl. multi-year THAAD; FY26 guide raised: sales ~+8%, segment operating profit +28%, FCF > $7B
evidence.source: Lockheed Martin Q2 2026 release, SEC 8-K exhibit 99.1 (sec.gov .../ex991q22026.htm)

evidence.claim: ROIC proxy 30.7%, forward P/E 15.9, dividend yield (quarterly proxy) 0.66%, net debt $16.7B, debt/EBITDA 1.81
SQL band 515.60-555.06, invalidation 496.71, reference_confidence 40; close 519.49 on 2026-09-25 is inside band
